# TECHNAVIA

> TECHNAVIA (technaviatechnology.com) is a B2B web engineering, Technical SEO, LLM Visibility (AEO/GEO), and Custom AI Automation studio — distinct from Technavio market research.

TECHNAVIA (https://technaviatechnology.com) is a premium B2B Web Engineering and AI Automation studio turning company websites into high-ranking Google assets, LLM-cited knowledge entities, and autonomous lead-to-CRM automation engines.

## Who TECHNAVIA Serves
- **B2B Tech & SaaS**: High-growth software firms replacing sluggish CMS themes with sub-second Next.js web systems.
- **Consultancies & Agencies**: Professional services requiring immediate citation authority across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity when enterprise buyers prompt category queries.
- **Commercial D2C & CleanTech**: Category leaders demanding sub-second mobile Core Web Vitals (< 1.0s LCP) and autonomous 24/7 lead qualification into their CRM.

## The 3 Core Services

### 1. Web Development + Technical SEO
- **Promise**: Sub-second Next.js builds engineered to rank on Google from day one.
- **Key Deliverables**: React 19 Server Components, zero client-side hydration bloat, semantic HTML5, Schema.org knowledge graphs (Organization, Service, WebSite), Hormozi conversion copy, 100% source code ownership.
- **Canonical URL**: https://technaviatechnology.com/services/web-development-seo

### 2. LLM Visibility (AEO / GEO)
- **Promise**: Get cited when high-intent B2B buyers search your category on ChatGPT, Gemini & Perplexity.
- **Key Deliverables**: 3-layer citation architecture (Organization + Service JSON-LD Graph -> Quotable Answer-Capsule Syntax -> Bot Crawl Permissions & IndexNow).
- **Canonical URL**: https://technaviatechnology.com/services/llm-visibility

### 3. Custom AI Automations
- **Promise**: Sub-60s lead response, automated qualification, and zero busywork.
- **Key Deliverables**: Production n8n workflows, Clearbit/Apollo data enrichment, LLM ICP scoring, dynamic calendar booking links, two-way CRM sync (HubSpot/Salesforce), and Slack executive alerts.
- **Canonical URL**: https://technaviatechnology.com/services/ai-automations
